snippet.title: Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037410/Fish_Idle_2_Underwater_Mystery

Dive into the most fun idle fishing arcade game! Manage your Fish Kingdoms with automated fishing, upgrade your boat and gear, invest in passive income, and outsmart the market. Become the ultimate fish tycoon!

Developed by
Multicast ​
